title: perf(app-shell): a packaged app's record route reads the objects pointing at the record through its package scope, not the registry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb5CaEoBAVTjjB36mfo8oJQZ)_

Fixes #29681

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6596739699. Design approved by the seat before code (step 1: the provider's existing `{ packageId, names }` scope, not a names-only read beside it).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在有包的应用(如 CRM 示例的 `crm_app`)里打开一条记录、而该对象没有声明记录页时,不再下载整张对象注册表;改为读应用所在包的对象列表,再按名读取查找目标和其他包里指向该对象的对象(这些对象已在应用 bundle 里,不发请求)。
- 为什么改:在 CRM 示例上,这类记录页一次打开共 1,584,710 B,其中整张对象注册表 561,247 B、视图整表 7,014 B;改后为 1,075,729 B,少了约 510 KB。
- 风险与回滚:相关列表的集合与顺序都不变,实测改前改后页面正文逐字一致(只差相对时间),另一个包里新建的 Visits 对象在改前改后都排在同一位置。导航外的对象、无 bundle、草稿预览、记录抽屉仍读整表,实测抽屉与改前同为 24 个请求。回滚方法是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts` 记录分支里 `!page` 的处理(去掉了有包应用直接读整表的那一行);测试文件末尾新增的 objectstack#29681 那组用例。
- 两分钟验证:打开 CRM 应用的任意一条客户(Account)记录,在开发者工具 Network 里过滤 `meta/object`:应看到 `meta/object?package=com.example.crm` 和几条按名读取,没有不带参数的 `meta/object`;页签仍是 Activities、Contacts、Leads、Opportunities。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A record route whose object has no declared record page draws a synthesized page, which derives its related lists from every object that points at the record's object. Since #29697 an app with no package reads those objects by name from the app bundle (`BundledReads.objectsReferencing`). A packaged app still answered `scope: null` there and read the whole object registry. It now reads the same names through its package scope, the shape its object routes already read: the package list (`/meta/object?package=`), then by name each name the list does not hold. A pointing object from another package is one of those names, answered from the bundle with no request. `inRelatedOrder` keeps the bundle's (object-list) order.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`: the record arm's `!page` branch no longer returns `scope: null` for a packaged app; it hands `packageId` to `readObjectRouteNames`. The module header says so.
- No `MetadataProvider.tsx` or `bundledReads.ts` change: `objectsReferencing` was never package-gated, and the provider's `{ packageId, names }` scope already reads a name outside the package by name.

Unchanged: an object outside the app's navigation, no bundle, draft preview, a declared record page, a record form overlay, the record drawer (reads the registry, live: same 24 requests), the package-less route, and the `/meta/page` list.

## Why

Measured on a production Console (app-crm, `crm_app`, Initech `crm_account`, no declared record page), the registry was 561,247 B of the record open's 1,584,710 B.

## Tests

In the shared harness `console/__tests__/AppContent.packagelessRecordRelated-29552.test.tsx`, over the real `MetadataProvider` and `AppContent`, a new top-level describe (7 cases). The fixture adds `ops_visit`, an object outside the app's package that points at the account, listed between the package's own objects:

- the packaged record route reads no unscoped `/meta/object`: exactly `object?package=app.crm` and `object/sys_user` (the cross-package object comes from the bundle);
- the related lists equal the registry's in set AND order, `ops_visit.account` in its registry place (pinned literally);
- an object pointed at only from another package (`crm_case` to `crm_contact`) draws that list;
- CONTROLs: a declared record page reads the objects it binds as before; an object outside the navigation reads the registry; no bundle reads the registry; a record drawer reads the registry.

**Flipped:** the old CONTROL "a packaged app's record route is unchanged: the registry, and nothing by name" is removed; the new describe replaces it. The package-less pins are byte-unchanged in their assertions. The harness now reads its object set and page list from `server.objects` / `server.pages` (reset to the old values in `beforeEach`), so the packaged describe can add `ops_visit` without touching them.

Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD:
- A1, put the package gate back (`if (packageId) return { candidate, scope: null, … }`): 2 red at daaec33a, the packaged no-unscoped-read pin and the cross-package `crm_case` pin (the order pin stays green: the registry draws that order too). At ad4df191 it was 3 red: the drawer pin then also asserted a package-list call that only the harness makes, narrowed in daaec33a (see Acceptance notes);
- A2, drop `inRelatedOrder`: 2 red, the packaged order pin with `ops_visit` and the package-less `requiresObject` order pin.

Sweep at ad4df191: the 135 app-shell test files naming `AppContent`, `appObjectScope` or `bundledReads`, plus every provider test, 1,118 tests passed. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (both programs) exit 0 at ad4df191 and again at the merged head f440eb5c; ESLint 0 errors on the changed files. Harness 17/17 at daaec33a. Final head 8d42b239 merges main again (42ff86f6); none of the incoming commits touches the changed files or `MetadataProvider.tsx` / `bundledReads.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The record drawer pin.** In the harness, the drawer case also read the package list (the scope is read before the drawer's registry read starts). Live it does not: the registry is in flight first and the package scope is cut from it, so the drawer route is the same 24 requests, 1,586,558 B, as on main. The pin asserts only the registry read, as the package-less drawer pin does.
- **Sidebar presence.** With no registry read, the sidebar's presence gate answers from the package scope entry the route also reads (one `?package=` request shared). Sampled every 25 ms from navigation start, the sidebar went from 0 to all 7 entries in one step, at 1,109 ms before and 1,046 ms after; no entry flashed or went missing.
- **New by-name reads** that the registry used to answer: `sys_organization` 12,259 B and `sys_business_unit` 8,874 B (the account's lookup targets, without views, as the packaged list route reads them), and `sys_comment_reaction` 4,291 B (`RecordDetailView`'s `useObjectPresence` for reactions).
- **Cross-package inbound, live.** `ops_visit` was saved with `PUT /meta/object/ops_visit` (outside `com.example.crm`, a lookup to `crm_account`). The server put it in the `crm_app` bundle and the registry lists it as inbound of `crm_account`, so it is answered from the bundle. Before and after, the tabs are Overview, Activity, Activities, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, and the overflow menu holds Visits.
- `GET /api/v1/packages` (676,423 B) is read on this route before and after; not this card's read.

## Verification

Production Console (`pnpm build`, `pnpm console:build`), app-crm `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, `measure2.cjs` (about:blank then a fresh goto, cache disabled, CDP initiators). The before leg is a Console built from main's `appObjectScope.ts` (be6b15c7).

<details><summary>Per read, packaged crm_app Initech crm_account record (no declared page)</summary>

| read | before (be6b15c7) | after (ad4df191) | final (f440eb5c, merged main) |
|---|---|---|---|
| total | 24 requests, 1,584,710 B | 26 requests, 1,074,028 B | 26 requests, 1,075,729 B |
| `/meta/object` (registry) | 561,247 | none | none |
| `/meta/view` (whole) | 7,014 | none | none |
| `/meta/object?package=com.example.crm` | none | 32,008 | 32,008 |
| `object/sys_user` | 28,467 | 28,467 | 28,467 |
| `object/sys_organization`, `object/sys_business_unit` | none | 12,259 + 8,874 | 12,259 + 8,874 |
| `object/sys_comment_reaction` | none | 4,291 | 4,291 |
| `/meta/page` | 15,463 | 15,463 | 15,463 |
| record drawer over the route (`?recordId=`) | n/a | n/a | 24 requests, 1,586,558 B: registry 561,247 + view 7,014, no `?package=` |

Page text before and after is identical except the record's relative created time. Data, screenshots (`tabs.png`, `tabs-overflow-open.png`, `record-full.png` per leg) and scripts (`measure2.cjs`, `tabs.cjs`, `probe.cjs`, `xpkg.cjs`) are in the project's `issue-29681/measure/`.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; ESLint 0 errors on the changed files.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
